# Project instructions

- Keep the quiz as a standalone `index.html` with inline CSS and JavaScript. Do not add dependencies, assets, a server, or other files unless explicitly requested.
- Keep changes focused and preserve the existing 10-question flow, scoring, feedback, progress, and score-based results.
- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard access and visible focus, responsive layout, both color-scheme themes, and reduced-motion support.
- Verify UI changes in the integrated browser using the `file://` preview. Use a real keyboard-capable browser test when keyboard interaction needs verification; do not treat scripted `.click()` calls as keyboard testing.
